name: keystrike
description: Keystrike is a fast typing game you play right inside the chat: type the falling words to shoot them down before they reach your ship.

interface.longDescription: Keystrike turns typing practice into an arcade game that runs right in your conversation. Words fall from the top of the screen toward your ship; type a word correctly and your ship fires a laser that destroys it. Clear words quickly to build combos and raise your score, and press Enter to trigger an EMP that wipes out every word near your ship when things get crowded. Each round gets faster, so it works both as a quick break and as a way to build typing speed and accuracy. Keystrike runs entirely inside the chat window: there is no sign-up, no account, and nothing to install, and it does not collect or store any personal data.
